updates.text: Adams won a contact release while losing quick-concept timing through an extra step. Drake corrected it; he kept the timing August 1 against Harris and lost a release to Talib. WR1 and WR3 remain open comparisons.
updates.source: Source: [dated camp observations](career/2014/Training_Camp_and_Preseason/Training_Camp/training_report.md). This coaching update preserves the opening grades above.

updates.text: All 59 offensive snaps at X with four catches on nine targets for 54 and two touchdowns: the 42-yard Bunch Mesh with HALF on second-and-long from the Indianapolis 42 at 12:37 of the second quarter, with no tackler recorded, and the 3-yard Boot Flood Right from the 3 on second-and-goal at 2:40 of the third; the 2 on the Trey Stick and the 7 on the Y-Cross with SOLID on the first field-goal drive. Five throws his way fell incomplete, the Y-Cross with SOLID twice (the opener's seventh call and the first-and-10 from the Indianapolis 17), the Drive with HALF in the two-minute drive, the Trey Stick and the first Boot Flood Right from the 7; the play-by-play names no defender on any of them, so the separation and the throw are the film's. A minor lower-extremity injury was logged at the end of the third-quarter drive that ended with Cousins's touchdown run at 6:20; he was not removed and the second touchdown came after it: out, projected return September 26, reassessment September 22 ([medical record](career/2014/Team_Operations/Medical/incidents/davante_adams_2014-09-21.md)). No role change follows; Nicks's return to X still waits on a full practice week.

short.text: Davante Adams is a rookie who has played X for Jacksonville, active for {{2014.regular.games:words}} games with {{2014.regular.receptions}} catches for {{2014.regular.receiving_yards}} yards and {{2014.regular.receiving_touchdowns:words}} touchdowns. He has a large catch radius and strong hands, and his routes are polished at the top of the stem. His long speed is average, and his release against NFL press was unproven when he arrived; in camp he won one contact release and lost another to Aqib Talib.
